No. APPSC-12/37/2024 Dated Itanagar, the 25th September 2025
ADVERTISEMENT NO.4
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission invites application for filling up of 25
(Twenty Five) posts of Assistant Section Officer though Limited Departmental Competitive
Examination (LDCE) from following candidates:
(l) Upper Division Clerks of the District Ministerial Cadre who have completed 6 (six)
years of regular service in the grade and possessing graduation in any discipline from a
recognized university.
(2) Senior Secretariat Assistants of the Arunachal Pradesh Secretariat Clerical Service
Cadre who have completed 6 (six) years of regular service in the grade and possessing
graduation in any discipline from a recognized university.
The post vacancy detail is tabulated below:
(A) ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
(1) Bachelor Degree/ Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university.
(2) Completed 6(six) years ofregular service in the grade ofUpper Division Clerk ofthe
District Ministerial Cadre or Senior Secretariat Assistant ofthe Arunachal Pradesh
Secretariat Clerical Service Cadre
(3) Possessing at-least lyg 'Very Good' consecutive ACR/ APAR grading for the last 5
(five) years.
(B)HOW TO APPLY
(1) Application Form is available for download in the APPSC website https://appsc.gov.in. The
duly filled-in application form must be recommended by the Cadre Controlling Authority along
with details of the ACR/ APAR grading of last five consecutive years.
(2) Only applications nominated by the Cadre Controlling Authority with at-least !g 'Very Good'
consecutive ACR/ APAR grading oflast 5 (five) years shall be considered.
(3) The duly filled-in application forms nominated by the Cadre Controlling Authority must also
enclose the documents listed herein at (E).
(4) All such duly nominated applications must be submitted in the offtce of APPSC on or before

The eligible candidates will have to appear in written examination in subjects mentioned
below followed by Viva-Voce to be conducted by the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service
Commission.

Note: In order to qualifr for interview, candidates must score an aggregate of 33%o of the
total marks in the written examination comprising of !@ papers, subject to condition that
the candidate scores at least 207o in each Subject/ Paper of the written examination.
(D) APPLICATION FEE
Candidates are required to pay fee of t150/- (Rupees One Hundred Fifty) only for APST
candidate and t 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred) only for other candidate in form of IPO.
(E) DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR SUBMISSION ALONG WITH THE APPLICATION
I . Latest/Recent color passport size photo. The photograph is to be in white background, front
faced and without headgear and sunglasses.
2. Self-Attested photocopy of Degree certificates and Mark Sheets issued by the Assistant
Registrar/Registrar/Controller of Examination/Vice-Chancellor of the concemed University
to ascertain degree.
3. Self-Attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate for proof of age issued by the Board.
4. Self-Attested Photocopy of APST certificate and copy of PRC/Aadhar Card in case of
General candidates.
5. Self- Attested photocopy ofappointment order to the post.
6. IPO of amount deposited as fee.
(F) LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION: 30th October 2025 (Thursday)
NOTE:
(1) The decision ofthe Commission as to the eligibility or otherwise of candidate for admission to
written examination/interview or selection will be final and no correspondence or personal
enquiry will be entertained.
(2) Date for Written Examination is scheduled on 28th November 2025 (Friday). Date of
Interview of eligible candidates shall be intimated separately.
(3) Eligible candidates will have to produce fie above-mentioned (at Point E)
Certificates/Documents and Mark Sheets in original at the time of interview, failing which
helshe shall not be allowed to appe.u in the intervierv.
(4) The Selection will be provisional and subject to verification of requisite documents/
qualifications by the indenting department.
